title: Android Editor crash in `RuntimeNodeSelect::_update_view_2d()` (analytics report)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.6.stable (analytics report on Google Play for the Godot Editor app)
- Didn't check earlier versions

### System information

Android 15 & 16 Beta, Samsung Galaxy A15 and A36 5G, Xiaomi Pad 7 Pro (probably not device specific)

### Issue description

This is a copy of a Google Play crash report for the Godot Editor on Android after it was updated to 4.6.stable yesterday.

We don't have more info than just the stacktrace, so we have to work from that.

Reports for maintainers with access:
https://play.google.com/console/u/0/developers/5310120689138741555/app/4972363226496209566/vitals/crashes/b71a4a644e5cba4b7c22e9156127ed1d/details?days=28&isUserPerceived=true&versionCode=40600500

`Camera2D::set_anchor_mode(Camera2D::AnchorMode)+470` is just this line:
```cpp
void Camera2D::set_anchor_mode(AnchorMode p_anchor_mode) {
        if (anchor_mode == p_anchor_mode) { // HERE
                return;
        }
        anchor_mode = p_anchor_mode;
        _update_scroll();
}
```

The only way that can cause a crash AFAIK is if `this` is null/freed so the problem is likely higher up the stack trace that's trying to update a Camera2D that's gone.
